title: Cybersecurity Program
description: Each Covered Entity shall maintain a cybersecurity program designed to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the Covered Entity's Information Systems.
implementation_guidance: Develop and document a comprehensive cybersecurity program that addresses all aspects of information security. The program should be based on risk assessment and aligned with business objectives.

title: Information Security Policy
description: The cybersecurity program shall be based on the Covered Entity's Risk Assessment and designed to identify and assess internal and external cybersecurity risks.
implementation_guidance: Create documented information security policies that are approved by senior management and communicated to all employees. Review and update policies at least annually.

title: Cybersecurity Policy
description: Each Covered Entity shall implement and maintain a written policy or policies, approved by a Senior Officer or the Covered Entity's board of directors.
implementation_guidance: Document cybersecurity policies covering information security, data governance, asset inventory, access controls, business continuity, systems operations, vendor management, and incident response.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
description: Each Covered Entity shall designate a qualified individual responsible for overseeing and implementing the Covered Entity's cybersecurity program and enforcing its cybersecurity policy.
implementation_guidance: Appoint a CISO or equivalent role with appropriate authority, qualifications, and resources. The CISO should report regularly to the board or senior management.

title: CISO Reporting
description: The CISO shall report in writing at least annually to the Covered Entity's board of directors or equivalent governing body.
implementation_guidance: Prepare and deliver annual written reports to the board covering cybersecurity program status, material risks, and remediation efforts.

title: Penetration Testing and Vulnerability Assessments
description: The cybersecurity program shall include monitoring and testing, developed in accordance with the Covered Entity's Risk Assessment, designed to assess the effectiveness of the cybersecurity program.
implementation_guidance: Conduct annual penetration testing and bi-annual vulnerability assessments. Address critical and high vulnerabilities within defined timeframes.

title: Audit Trail
description: Each Covered Entity shall securely maintain systems that, to the extent applicable and based on its Risk Assessment, include audit trails designed to detect and respond to Cybersecurity Events.
implementation_guidance: Implement comprehensive logging for all critical systems. Retain logs for at least 5 years for financial transactions and 3 years for other records. Ensure logs are tamper-evident.

title: Access Privileges
description: As part of its cybersecurity program, each Covered Entity shall limit user access privileges to Information Systems that provide access to Nonpublic Information.
implementation_guidance: Implement least privilege access controls. Review access rights periodically and remove access promptly upon role change or termination.

title: Application Security
description: Each Covered Entity's cybersecurity program shall include written procedures, guidelines and standards designed to ensure the use of secure development practices for in-house developed applications.
implementation_guidance: Establish secure SDLC practices including code reviews, security testing, and vulnerability remediation. Evaluate security of third-party applications before deployment.

title: Risk Assessment
description: Each Covered Entity shall conduct a periodic Risk Assessment of the Covered Entity's Information Systems sufficient to inform the design of the cybersecurity program.
implementation_guidance: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments at least annually and when significant changes occur. Document risks, likelihood, impact, and mitigation strategies.

title: Cybersecurity Personnel and Intelligence
description: Each Covered Entity shall employ cybersecurity personnel sufficient to manage the Covered Entity's cybersecurity risks and to perform the core cybersecurity functions.
implementation_guidance: Ensure adequate staffing for cybersecurity operations. Provide ongoing training and utilize threat intelligence to stay informed of emerging threats.

title: Third Party Service Provider Security Policy
description: Each Covered Entity shall implement written policies and procedures designed to ensure the security of Information Systems and Nonpublic Information that are accessible to, or held by, Third Party Service Providers.
implementation_guidance: Develop vendor security assessment procedures. Require contractual security obligations and conduct periodic reviews of third-party security practices.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Each Covered Entity shall use effective controls, which may include multi-factor authentication or risk-based authentication, to protect against unauthorized access to Nonpublic Information or Information Systems.
implementation_guidance: Implement MFA for all privileged access, remote access, and access to nonpublic information. Consider risk-based authentication for additional scenarios.

title: Limitations on Data Retention
description: Each Covered Entity shall include policies and procedures for the secure disposal on a periodic basis of any Nonpublic Information that is no longer necessary for business operations.
implementation_guidance: Establish data retention schedules and secure disposal procedures. Regularly review and purge data that is no longer required for business or regulatory purposes.

title: Training and Monitoring
description: Each Covered Entity shall implement risk-based policies, procedures and controls designed to monitor the activity of Authorized Users and detect unauthorized access.
implementation_guidance: Deploy user activity monitoring solutions. Establish baselines and alerts for anomalous behavior. Investigate and respond to detected anomalies.

title: Cybersecurity Awareness Training
description: Each Covered Entity shall provide regular cybersecurity awareness training for all personnel that is updated to reflect risks identified by the Covered Entity in its Risk Assessment.
implementation_guidance: Conduct annual security awareness training for all employees. Include phishing simulations and role-specific training for personnel with elevated access.

title: Encryption of Nonpublic Information
description: Each Covered Entity shall implement controls, including encryption, to protect Nonpublic Information held or transmitted by the Covered Entity both in transit and at rest.
implementation_guidance: Encrypt all nonpublic information at rest and in transit using industry-standard algorithms (AES-256, TLS 1.2+). Document compensating controls if encryption is not feasible.

title: Incident Response Plan
description: Each Covered Entity shall establish a written incident response plan designed to promptly respond to, and recover from, any Cybersecurity Event materially affecting the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the Covered Entity's Information Systems.
implementation_guidance: Document incident response procedures including roles, communication plans, containment strategies, and recovery procedures. Test the plan annually.

title: Notices to Superintendent
description: Each Covered Entity shall notify the superintendent as promptly as possible but in no event later than 72 hours from a determination that a Cybersecurity Event has occurred.
implementation_guidance: Establish procedures for timely incident notification. Maintain contact information for regulatory reporting. Document all reportable events and notifications.

title: Asset Inventory
description: Each Covered Entity shall maintain a complete, accurate, and documented asset inventory, including a listing of all Information Systems.
implementation_guidance: Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all hardware, software, and data assets. Include classification, ownership, and location information.

title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
description: Each Covered Entity shall establish and maintain a business continuity and disaster recovery plan reasonably designed to ensure the availability and functionality of the Covered Entity's Information Systems.
implementation_guidance: Develop and test BC/DR plans annually. Define RTO/RPO objectives and ensure backup systems can meet these requirements.

title: Policies for Information Security
description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.
implementation_guidance: Develop comprehensive information security policies aligned with business objectives. Ensure policies are approved by top management and communicated to all stakeholders.

title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
description: All information security responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.
implementation_guidance: Define and document security roles and responsibilities. Ensure segregation of duties where appropriate. Communicate responsibilities to relevant personnel.

title: Segregation of Duties
description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization's assets.
implementation_guidance: Identify and separate conflicting duties. Implement compensating controls where segregation is not feasible. Review access regularly.

title: Access Control
description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.
implementation_guidance: Develop access control policy based on business needs. Implement role-based access control with principle of least privilege.

title: Identity Management
description: The full lifecycle of identities shall be managed.
implementation_guidance: Implement identity management processes covering provisioning, modifications, and deprovisioning. Conduct regular access reviews.

title: Authentication Information
description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process.
implementation_guidance: Implement strong password policies. Use MFA where appropriate. Secure storage and transmission of credentials.

title: Information Security for Use of Cloud Services
description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.
implementation_guidance: Assess cloud service providers before engagement. Define security requirements and monitor compliance. Plan for service transitions.

title: Information Security Incident Management Planning
description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.
implementation_guidance: Develop incident response plan with defined roles. Establish communication procedures. Train incident response team.

title: Response to Information Security Incidents
description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.
implementation_guidance: Follow documented procedures for incident response. Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents. Document all actions taken.

title: Information Security During Disruption
description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
implementation_guidance: Integrate security requirements into business continuity plans. Ensure security controls remain effective during disruptions.

title: ICT Readiness for Business Continuity
description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.
implementation_guidance: Define recovery objectives. Implement redundancy and backup solutions. Test recovery procedures regularly.

title: Screening
description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis.
implementation_guidance: Conduct background checks appropriate to the role. Consider ongoing screening for sensitive positions.

title: Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
description: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy.
implementation_guidance: Provide security awareness training to all employees. Include role-specific training. Track completion and update content regularly.

title: Physical Security Perimeters
description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
implementation_guidance: Define and implement physical security perimeters. Control entry points and monitor for unauthorized access.

title: Physical Security Monitoring
description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
implementation_guidance: Implement surveillance and monitoring systems. Review logs and respond to alerts. Integrate with access control systems.

title: User Endpoint Devices
description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.
implementation_guidance: Implement endpoint protection solutions. Encrypt device storage. Apply security configurations and patches.

title: Privileged Access Rights
description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
implementation_guidance: Limit privileged access to minimum required. Implement PAM solutions. Monitor and audit privileged activities.

title: Secure Authentication
description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
implementation_guidance: Implement MFA for sensitive systems. Use strong authentication protocols. Protect authentication credentials.

title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.
implementation_guidance: Conduct regular vulnerability scans. Prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities based on risk. Track remediation status.

title: Configuration Management
description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.
implementation_guidance: Establish secure baseline configurations. Use configuration management tools. Monitor for configuration drift.

title: Data Leakage Prevention
description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.
implementation_guidance: Implement DLP solutions for email, endpoints, and network. Define and monitor for sensitive data patterns. Respond to policy violations.

title: Logging
description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
implementation_guidance: Implement centralized logging. Define log retention periods. Protect logs from tampering. Regularly review and analyze logs.

title: Monitoring Activities
description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
implementation_guidance: Implement SIEM or monitoring solutions. Define alerting thresholds. Investigate anomalies promptly.

title: Networks Security
description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
implementation_guidance: Implement network segmentation. Use firewalls and IDS/IPS. Monitor network traffic and respond to threats.

title: Use of Cryptography
description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
implementation_guidance: Define cryptographic standards and key management procedures. Use approved algorithms. Protect and rotate keys appropriately.

title: COSO Principle 1: Demonstrates Commitment to Integrity and Ethical Values
description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
implementation_guidance: Establish code of conduct. Communicate ethical expectations. Enforce accountability for violations.

title: Board Independence and Oversight
description: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control.
implementation_guidance: Ensure board oversight of security. Provide regular security reports to board. Maintain board independence.

title: Information and Communication - Internal
description: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.
implementation_guidance: Establish internal communication channels for security. Ensure relevant information reaches decision makers.

title: Risk Assessment - Objectives
description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to objectives.
implementation_guidance: Define security objectives aligned with business goals. Identify and document risks to achieving objectives.

title: Risk Identification and Analysis
description: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyzes risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.
implementation_guidance: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments. Analyze likelihood and impact. Prioritize risks for treatment.

title: Monitoring Activities - Ongoing and Separate Evaluations
description: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.
implementation_guidance: Implement continuous monitoring. Conduct periodic control assessments. Track and report on control effectiveness.

title: Selection and Development of Control Activities
description: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.
implementation_guidance: Design controls based on risk assessment. Document control objectives and procedures. Implement controls consistently.

title: General Technology Controls
description: The entity also selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.
implementation_guidance: Implement IT general controls covering change management, access controls, and operations. Monitor control effectiveness.

title: Logical and Physical Access Controls
description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events.
implementation_guidance: Implement access control systems. Use role-based access. Monitor access and investigate anomalies.

title: User Access Registration and Authorization
description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users.
implementation_guidance: Establish formal access request and approval process. Verify identity before granting access. Document all access grants.

title: User Access Removal
description: The entity removes access to protected information assets when the access is no longer required.
implementation_guidance: Implement timely access removal upon termination or role change. Conduct periodic access reviews. Document access removals.

title: Transmission Encryption
description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.
implementation_guidance: Encrypt data in transit using TLS 1.2+. Implement secure protocols for all external communications.

title: Access Restrictions to Data at Rest
description: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes.
implementation_guidance: Implement data classification. Control data movement based on classification. Monitor for unauthorized data transfers.

title: Detection and Monitoring
description: To meet its objectives, the entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities.
implementation_guidance: Implement configuration monitoring. Alert on unauthorized changes. Investigate and remediate configuration drift.

title: Security Event Monitoring
description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors.
implementation_guidance: Implement SIEM or security monitoring. Define use cases and alerts. Monitor and respond to security events.

title: Security Incident Response
description: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure of the entity to meet its objectives and, if so, takes actions to prevent or address such failures.
implementation_guidance: Evaluate all security events. Classify and prioritize incidents. Take appropriate response actions.

title: Incident Response and Recovery
description: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program to understand, contain, remediate, and communicate security incidents.
implementation_guidance: Execute incident response procedures. Contain and eradicate threats. Recover systems and communicate appropriately.

title: Incident Recovery
description: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.
implementation_guidance: Plan for incident recovery. Test recovery procedures. Document lessons learned and improve processes.

title: Change Management
description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.
implementation_guidance: Implement formal change management process. Test changes before deployment. Document and approve all changes.

title: Business Continuity Planning
description: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover critical systems and resume normal operations in a timely manner.
implementation_guidance: Develop business continuity plans. Define recovery objectives. Test plans regularly and update based on results.

title: Vendor Risk Management
description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.
implementation_guidance: Assess vendor security before engagement. Monitor vendor compliance. Include security requirements in contracts.

title: Organizational Context
description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management.
implementation_guidance: Document organizational mission and objectives. Align cybersecurity program with business goals.

title: Risk Management Strategy
description: Risk management strategy is established, including risk tolerance and appetite.
implementation_guidance: Define risk tolerance and appetite. Document risk management strategy. Communicate to stakeholders.

title: Roles and Responsibilities
description: Organizational cybersecurity roles and responsibilities are established and communicated.
implementation_guidance: Define and document security roles. Assign responsibilities clearly. Communicate to all personnel.

title: Policy
description: Cybersecurity policy is established based on organizational context, strategy, and priorities.
implementation_guidance: Develop comprehensive security policies. Align with organizational strategy. Review and update regularly.

title: Asset Inventory - Hardware
description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained.
implementation_guidance: Maintain complete hardware inventory. Include all physical and virtual assets. Update inventory regularly.

title: Asset Inventory - Software
description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained.
implementation_guidance: Maintain software inventory including versions. Track licenses and dependencies. Update regularly.

title: Data Inventory
description: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained.
implementation_guidance: Document data flows and network communications. Classify data by sensitivity. Map data to systems and processes.

title: Vulnerability Identification
description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded.
implementation_guidance: Conduct regular vulnerability scans. Validate findings. Maintain vulnerability database.

title: Threat Intelligence
description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources.
implementation_guidance: Subscribe to threat intelligence feeds. Participate in information sharing. Apply intelligence to risk decisions.

title: Risk Assessment
description: Internal and external threats are identified and documented.
implementation_guidance: Identify and assess threats. Document threat scenarios. Update threat assessment regularly.

title: Identity Management
description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization.
implementation_guidance: Implement identity lifecycle management. Use strong authentication. Manage credentials securely.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated.
implementation_guidance: Implement MFA for all users. Require MFA for privileged access. Use hardware tokens where appropriate.

title: Access Permissions
description: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined and managed.
implementation_guidance: Define access permissions based on roles. Implement least privilege. Review and certify access regularly.

title: Security Awareness Training
description: Personnel are provided with awareness and training.
implementation_guidance: Provide security awareness training to all. Include role-specific training. Track completion and effectiveness.

title: Data-at-Rest Protection
description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected.
implementation_guidance: Encrypt sensitive data at rest. Implement access controls. Monitor for unauthorized access.

title: Data-in-Transit Protection
description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected.
implementation_guidance: Encrypt all data in transit. Use TLS 1.2 or higher. Validate certificates.

title: Configuration Management
description: Configuration management practices are established and applied.
implementation_guidance: Establish secure baselines. Manage configurations centrally. Monitor for drift.

title: Software Maintenance
description: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
implementation_guidance: Maintain software patching program. Replace end-of-life software. Remove unauthorized software.

title: Incident Response Planning
description: Incident response plans are established, maintained, and tested.
implementation_guidance: Develop incident response plan. Define roles and procedures. Test plan regularly.

title: Network Monitoring
description: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
implementation_guidance: Monitor network traffic. Detect anomalies and threats. Alert on suspicious activity.

title: Personnel Activity Monitoring
description: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
implementation_guidance: Monitor user activities. Detect insider threats. Investigate anomalous behavior.

title: External Service Provider Monitoring
description: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
implementation_guidance: Monitor third-party activities. Review service provider reports. Assess ongoing compliance.

title: Event Analysis
description: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities.
implementation_guidance: Analyze security events. Correlate with threat intelligence. Determine impact and scope.

title: Incident Management
description: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties.
implementation_guidance: Execute incident response procedures. Coordinate with stakeholders. Document all actions.

title: Incident Analysis
description: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident.
implementation_guidance: Conduct root cause analysis. Document findings. Apply lessons learned.

title: Incident Containment
description: Incidents are contained.
implementation_guidance: Implement containment strategies. Isolate affected systems. Prevent further damage.

title: Incident Mitigation
description: Incidents are eradicated.
implementation_guidance: Remove threat actors. Eliminate malware. Restore systems to known good state.

title: Recovery Planning Execution
description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed.
implementation_guidance: Execute recovery procedures. Restore services in priority order. Verify successful recovery.

title: Network Security Controls
description: Network security controls are installed and maintained.
implementation_guidance: Implement firewalls and network security controls. Define and enforce traffic rules. Review configurations regularly.

title: Network Diagram
description: Configuration standards for NSC rulesets are defined, implemented, and maintained.
implementation_guidance: Maintain current network diagrams. Document all connections. Update when changes occur.

title: Secure Configurations
description: Processes and mechanisms for applying secure configurations to all system components are defined and understood.
implementation_guidance: Define secure configuration standards. Remove default credentials. Harden systems before deployment.

title: Configuration Standards
description: Configuration standards are developed, implemented, and maintained.
implementation_guidance: Document configuration standards for all system types. Apply standards consistently. Review and update regularly.

title: Account Data Protection
description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting stored account data are defined and understood.
implementation_guidance: Define data protection requirements. Minimize data storage. Protect all stored account data.

title: PAN Storage Encryption
description: PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored.
implementation_guidance: Encrypt or hash all stored PAN. Use strong cryptography. Manage keys securely.

title: Transmission Encryption
description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting cardholder data with strong cryptography during transmission over open, public networks are defined and documented.
implementation_guidance: Encrypt cardholder data in transit. Use TLS 1.2+. Validate certificates.

title: Anti-Malware
description: Processes and mechanisms for protecting all systems and networks from malicious software are defined and understood.
implementation_guidance: Deploy anti-malware on all systems. Keep signatures current. Monitor for threats.

title: Anti-Malware Deployment
description: An anti-malware solution is deployed on all system components.
implementation_guidance: Install anti-malware on all endpoints and servers. Configure for real-time protection. Enable automatic updates.

title: Secure Development
description: Processes and mechanisms for developing and maintaining secure systems and software are defined and understood.
implementation_guidance: Implement secure SDLC. Train developers on security. Review code for vulnerabilities.

title: Vulnerability Management
description: Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed.
implementation_guidance: Monitor for vulnerabilities. Assess and prioritize. Remediate critical vulnerabilities promptly.

title: Web Application Protection
description: Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks.
implementation_guidance: Deploy WAF or review applications annually. Address OWASP Top 10. Test regularly.

title: Access Control
description: Processes and mechanisms for restricting access to system components and cardholder data are defined and understood.
implementation_guidance: Define access control policies. Restrict access to need-to-know. Document and enforce.

title: Access Control System
description: An access control system is implemented.
implementation_guidance: Implement access control systems. Enforce least privilege. Log all access attempts.

title: User Identification
description: Processes and mechanisms for identifying users and authenticating access to system components are defined and understood.
implementation_guidance: Assign unique IDs to all users. Implement strong authentication. Manage credentials securely.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Strong authentication for users and administrators is established and managed.
implementation_guidance: Implement MFA for all remote access. Require MFA for admin access to CDE. Use approved MFA methods.

title: Password Requirements
description: Passwords/passphrases meet minimum complexity requirements.
implementation_guidance: Enforce minimum 12 character passwords. Require complexity. Prevent password reuse.

title: Physical Access Controls
description: Processes and mechanisms for restricting physical access to cardholder data are defined and understood.
implementation_guidance: Define physical access requirements. Control access to sensitive areas. Monitor and log access.

title: Logging and Monitoring
description: Processes and mechanisms for logging and monitoring all access to system components and cardholder data are defined and documented.
implementation_guidance: Log all access to cardholder data. Monitor logs for suspicious activity. Retain logs appropriately.

title: Audit Logs
description: Audit logs are enabled and active for all system components and cardholder data.
implementation_guidance: Enable logging on all systems. Capture required events. Protect log integrity.

title: Log Review
description: Audit logs are reviewed at least daily.
implementation_guidance: Review logs daily. Use automated tools for analysis. Investigate anomalies promptly.

title: Security Testing
description: Processes and mechanisms for regular testing of security of systems and networks are defined and understood.
implementation_guidance: Define security testing program. Conduct regular assessments. Document and remediate findings.

title: Vulnerability Scanning
description: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least quarterly.
implementation_guidance: Scan internal systems quarterly. Remediate high-risk vulnerabilities. Rescan to verify fixes.

title: Penetration Testing
description: External and internal penetration testing is regularly performed.
implementation_guidance: Conduct annual penetration tests. Test from inside and outside network. Remediate findings.

title: Information Security Policy
description: A comprehensive information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated.
implementation_guidance: Develop comprehensive security policy. Publish and communicate to all. Review annually.

title: Risk Assessment
description: A targeted risk analysis is performed for each PCI DSS requirement.
implementation_guidance: Conduct formal risk assessments. Document methodology and results. Update when changes occur.

title: Security Awareness Program
description: A formal security awareness program is implemented.
implementation_guidance: Implement security awareness training. Cover relevant threats. Train at hire and annually.

title: Third Party Management
description: A list of all TPSPs with which account data is shared is maintained.
implementation_guidance: Maintain inventory of TPSPs. Document data shared. Include in vendor management program.

title: Incident Response Plan
description: An incident response plan exists and is ready to be activated immediately.
implementation_guidance: Develop incident response plan. Define roles and procedures. Test plan annually.

title: AI Risk Management Policies
description: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and documented.
implementation_guidance: Identify applicable AI regulations. Document compliance requirements. Monitor regulatory changes.

title: AI Accountability
description: The characteristics of trustworthy AI are integrated into organizational policies, processes, and procedures.
implementation_guidance: Define AI ethics principles. Integrate into policies and procedures. Assign accountability.

title: AI Roles and Responsibilities
description: Roles and responsibilities and lines of communication related to mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks are documented and are clear to individuals and teams throughout the organization.
implementation_guidance: Define AI risk management roles. Document responsibilities clearly. Establish communication channels.

title: AI Risk Management Process
description: Decision-making related to mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks throughout the lifecycle is informed by a diverse team.
implementation_guidance: Include diverse perspectives in AI decisions. Document decision processes. Review decisions regularly.

title: AI Risk Culture
description: Organizational policies and practices are in place to foster a critical thinking and safety-first mindset in the design, development, deployment, and uses of AI systems.
implementation_guidance: Promote safety-first AI culture. Train personnel on AI risks. Encourage reporting concerns.

title: AI System Context
description: Intended purposes, potentially beneficial uses, context of use, and AI system impacts are defined and documented.
implementation_guidance: Document AI system purposes. Identify potential impacts. Define acceptable use boundaries.

title: AI Risk Identification
description: Organizational risk tolerances are determined and documented.
implementation_guidance: Define AI risk tolerance. Document thresholds. Apply to AI system decisions.

title: AI Data Requirements
description: The specific tasks and methods used to implement the tasks that the AI system will support are defined.
implementation_guidance: Define AI system tasks. Document data requirements. Specify implementation methods.

title: AI Bias Assessment
description: Potential benefits and harms are documented.
implementation_guidance: Assess potential AI biases. Document potential harms. Plan mitigation strategies.

title: AI Performance Metrics
description: Approaches and metrics for measurement of AI risks are developed.
implementation_guidance: Define AI performance metrics. Establish measurement approaches. Document baselines.

title: AI Testing
description: AI system evaluations are conducted in a manner consistent with the defined testing methods and metrics.
implementation_guidance: Test AI systems against defined metrics. Document results. Address deficiencies.

title: AI Fairness Assessment
description: The AI system is evaluated for safety, security, and resilience.
implementation_guidance: Evaluate AI for fairness. Test for bias in outputs. Document and address issues.

title: AI Model Monitoring
description: Approaches for measuring AI risks are documented and applied.
implementation_guidance: Monitor AI model performance. Track drift and degradation. Alert on anomalies.

title: AI Risk Prioritization
description: A determination is made as to whether the AI system achieves its intended purposes and is within risk tolerance levels.
implementation_guidance: Evaluate AI against intended purposes. Compare to risk tolerance. Document decisions.

title: AI Risk Response
description: Resources required to manage AI risks are taken into account.
implementation_guidance: Allocate resources for AI risk management. Plan response actions. Document resource needs.

title: AI Risk Mitigation
description: AI risks and benefits from third-party entities are managed.
implementation_guidance: Assess third-party AI risks. Manage vendor AI components. Monitor ongoing compliance.

title: AI Incident Management
description: Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are implemented.
implementation_guidance: Implement AI monitoring in production. Track incidents. Respond to AI-related issues.

title: Information Security Program
description: Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive information security program that contains administrative, technical, and physical safeguards.
implementation_guidance: Develop comprehensive security program. Address all safeguard types. Document and maintain program.

title: Qualified Individual
description: Designate a qualified individual responsible for overseeing and implementing the information security program.
implementation_guidance: Designate security program owner. Ensure adequate qualifications. Provide necessary authority and resources.

title: Risk Assessment
description: Identify reasonably foreseeable internal and external risks to the security, confidentiality, and integrity of customer information.
implementation_guidance: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments. Identify internal and external risks. Document findings and treatments.

title: Access Controls
description: Implement and periodically review access controls, including technical and physical controls to authenticate and permit access only to authorized users.
implementation_guidance: Implement access controls for customer information. Review access periodically. Enforce authentication requirements.

title: Data Inventory
description: Identify data, personnel, devices, systems, and facilities that make up the information system.
implementation_guidance: Inventory all components of information systems. Include data, personnel, and facilities. Update regularly.

title: Encryption
description: Protect by encryption all customer information held or transmitted both in transit and at rest.
implementation_guidance: Encrypt customer information at rest and in transit. Use strong encryption algorithms. Manage keys securely.

title: Secure Development
description: Adopt secure development practices for in-house developed applications.
implementation_guidance: Implement secure SDLC. Train developers on security. Review and test applications.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Implement multi-factor authentication for any individual accessing any information system.
implementation_guidance: Require MFA for system access. Implement for all users. Include remote access scenarios.

title: Disposal Procedures
description: Develop, implement, and maintain procedures for the secure disposal of customer information.
implementation_guidance: Define data disposal procedures. Securely destroy customer information. Document disposal activities.

title: Change Management
description: Adopt procedures for change management.
implementation_guidance: Implement change management process. Test changes before deployment. Document all changes.

title: Monitoring and Logging
description: Implement policies, procedures, and controls designed to monitor and log the activity of authorized users.
implementation_guidance: Monitor user activities. Maintain activity logs. Investigate suspicious activities.

title: Continuous Monitoring
description: Continuously monitor the effectiveness of safeguards' key controls, systems, and procedures.
implementation_guidance: Implement continuous monitoring. Assess control effectiveness. Adjust based on findings.

title: Annual Penetration Testing
description: Conduct annual penetration testing of information systems.
implementation_guidance: Conduct annual penetration tests. Address identified vulnerabilities. Document results and remediation.

title: Vulnerability Assessment
description: Conduct vulnerability assessments at least every six months.
implementation_guidance: Scan for vulnerabilities semi-annually. Prioritize and remediate findings. Track remediation status.

title: Security Training
description: Implement policies and procedures to ensure personnel are able to enact the information security program.
implementation_guidance: Provide security training to personnel. Cover program requirements. Update training regularly.

title: Security Awareness
description: Provide security awareness training to address current security threats and vulnerabilities.
implementation_guidance: Conduct security awareness training. Address current threats. Include phishing awareness.

title: Service Provider Oversight
description: Oversee service providers by taking reasonable steps to select and retain service providers that are capable of maintaining appropriate safeguards.
implementation_guidance: Assess service providers before engagement. Require contractual safeguards. Monitor ongoing compliance.

title: Program Updates
description: Evaluate and adjust the information security program in light of relevant circumstances.
implementation_guidance: Review program regularly. Adjust based on changes. Document program updates.

title: Incident Response Plan
description: Establish a written incident response plan designed to promptly respond to, and recover from, any security event materially affecting the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of customer information.
implementation_guidance: Develop incident response plan. Define roles and procedures. Test plan regularly.

title: Board Reporting
description: Require the qualified individual to report in writing, regularly and at least annually, to the board of directors.
implementation_guidance: Provide annual written reports to board. Cover program status and risks. Document board oversight.
